# Josef Tot

> Personal site of Josef Tot, IT professional and developer based in Austria. Blog posts on methods, tools and field notes, plus a list of his own projects.

## Sections
- [Blog](https://joseftot.com/blog/): thoughts, methods, field notes
- [Projects](https://joseftot.com/projects/): things he built and their status
- [About](https://joseftot.com/about/)
- [RSS](https://joseftot.com/rss.xml)
